info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Microsoft.Network api-version 2026-03-01 swagger. Every other official operation of this api-version returns HTTP 501 NotImplemented. Address metadata only: no packet is routed, filtered or translated and no public address is allocated (properties.ipAddress stays absent). Virtual networks need at least one valid, non-overlapping CIDR prefix; subnets must lie inside it and must not overlap one another. Subnets are separate child resources and are not embedded in the virtual network document. Security rules are stored inline in their network security group with unique names and priorities; default rules, effective rules, flow logs and $expand are not simulated. A network security group referenced by a subnet cannot be deleted; peering, gateways, NAT, route tables and every other Microsoft.Network operation are not implemented (HTTP 501).
info.title: Virtual networking (Microsoft.Network, simulator catalog)
